[1/3] Stop failed Blitz/Nightmare/Focus runs from setting or celebrating a personal best

impact_assessment.why: A Blitz/Nightmare/Focus run that cleared one board then lost showed NEW BEST and stored 320/650/270 as the mode benchmark; a failed attempt could outrank a later completed win
impact_assessment.benefits: Personal bests come only from completed runs, matching the daily result rule; losses no longer mint a BEST label or block a lower-scoring win
impact_assessment.risks: contract: mode bests now require a win, existing best values are untouched; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no schema change, losses simply do not call saveBest
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing pure bestEligible test; same deterministic Blitz loss before/after screenshots; loss-then-win played run proves only the win saves/celebrates; full gates

[1/3] Version persisted saves, migrate legacy saves, and refuse future versions without overwriting them

impact_assessment.why: The project guideline requires a format version and refusal of unsupported versions, but afterimage.profile/bests/daily have no version; a version-2 profile was loaded as 99 runs and the next hint save dropped the version and overwrote it
impact_assessment.benefits: Legacy saves migrate with version 1, future saves are left untouched, and the game cannot silently clobber a newer app's state
impact_assessment.risks: contract: structured saves gain version:1, legacy shape still loads; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: blocked keys skip writes until a new page/app version supports them
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing version/refusal tests first; future-version menu before/after screenshot; hint-save played run verifies raw bytes unchanged; full gates

[1/3] Count an abandoned run's attempt and cleared boards when Quit run returns to the menu

impact_assessment.why: Clearing two Focus boards then quitting leaves the menu at EYE LV 1 - 0 clears - 0 runs; quitting erases all lifetime progress even though the boards were cleared and a run was played
impact_assessment.benefits: Quit run keeps the attempt and its cleared boards in profile runs/clears/bestStreak; the menu's lifetime stats reflect how people actually play
impact_assessment.risks: contract: quit path only, finished result path unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: profile fields increment once and persist via versioned save
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing pure abandonedTotals test; same two-clear-quit menu screenshot pair; finished-run check proves no double count; full gates

[1/3] Stop claiming NEW BEST when the bests save is a blocked future format

impact_assessment.why: With a version-2 afterimage.bests, a full Focus win updated the in-memory best to 5,580, showed NEW BEST, and left the raw file untouched; after reload the best was gone
impact_assessment.benefits: The result screen never celebrates a best that cannot be persisted; a future-format save stays byte-identical while the current session continues
impact_assessment.risks: contract: saveBest returns false on a blocked key, no save schema changes; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: in-memory bests no longer update for blocked keys
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing blocked-saveBest test; same future-bests full Focus win before/after screenshots; reload check; full gates

impact_assessment.benefits: A blocked daily save behaves read-only: no best badge, no in-memory streak/result claim, and the future file stays byte-identical

[1/3] Make a blocked profile save read-only: no unpersisted freeze, first-clear or lifetime claims

impact_assessment.why: With a future-format afterimage.profile, a perfect daily win says Streak freeze earned and First Daily clear, updates in-memory freezes/runs/wins, but the raw file is untouched; reload loses all of it
impact_assessment.benefits: A blocked profile cannot mint or announce freezes/clears, and the future save stays byte-identical; the daily save (writable) still records its own result
impact_assessment.risks: contract: profile mutations and claims are gated on the profile key, daily/bests unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: blocked profile remains defaults in memory
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing earnFreeze blocked test; same future-profile perfect daily win before/after screenshots; reload/raw checks; full gates
